parameters.text:
=
You are a legal operations assistant for ClearDesk Consulting, a family and immigration law firm. You will receive a raw meeting transcript and must extract structured information from it.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object. Do not include any explanation, markdown, code fences, or text outside the JSON. The JSON must follow this exact structure:

{
  "summary": "Three sentence executive summary of the meeting.",
  "decisions": [
    "Decision one made during the meeting.",
    "Decision two made during the meeting."
  ],
  "actionItems": [
    {
      "description": "Full description of the task",
      "assignee": "First Last or null if unassigned",
      "dueDate": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not mentioned",
      "priority": "High or Medium or Low"
    }
  ],
  "attendeeNames": [
    "First Last"
  ]
}

Rules:
- summary must be exactly 3 sentences.
- decisions is an array of strings. If no decisions were made, return an empty array.
- actionItems is an array of objects. If no action items exist, return an empty array.
- For assignee: if the transcript does not name a specific person for a task, set assignee to null.
- For dueDate: use YYYY-MM-DD format. If no date is mentioned, set to null.
- priority: infer from urgency language. Default to Medium if unclear.
- attendeeNames: list all people mentioned by name in the transcript.
- Return nothing except the JSON object.

Meeting Title: {{ $json.meetingTitle }}
Meeting Date: {{ $json.meetingDate }}

Transcript:
{{ $json.transcript }}

parameters.content:
## Sheet - Triggers
fires every time a submission form is added to the sheet

## Data Cleaning
Intake and field cleaning
rename all fields to camelCase

## AI Brain
sends the full transcript to openAI chat model, prompt request only a json object - no markdown

## CODE & JSON PARSING
handles defensive parsing

## Route by Correct AI Response
if the AI parsing is correct or not?

## CODE & Action Item Splitting
splits actionItems array into individual n8n items - one per task

## Failed AI Response
send an email to the admin

## Routing by Unassigned
if there is an unassigned actionItem

## Route Path
1. true -> set - flagAsOrphaned to true
2. false -> append assigned task to tracker sheet

## Merge
merge all processed action items together

## Sheet - Append
append the action Items to Meeting Archive

## Route by Unassigned Tasks
1. true -> send an email to the organizer about the unassigned task
2. false -> send an email to all attendees

## Schedule - 4AM Trigger
fires every week on Friday at 4Am

## Sheet
read all open status tasks from the Task Tracker sheet

## CODE
filter tasks due within 7 days
Calculate any risk tasks

## Route by Risk
1. if there is risk -> send an email the ops manager
2. if not do nothing

## Global Error Handler
catches any crashes on the workflow
then send an email to the admin about the error
